annotations.title: Check PCB layout for blocking issues

description: Checks a current saved PCB layout at expectedRevision before export or review. A missing or stale layout requires generate_layout first. Reuses a current assessment or computes and saves one, which requires write access and normal compute capacity. If the board changes during the check, read get_board again. Returns hasBlockingIssues and actionable blockingIssues; no numeric score or deductions. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Saved board ID from list_boards, create_board, claim_guest_board, or an account board URL. Must be accessible to the current account or guest session.

expectedRevision.description: Saved revision returned by get_board. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

name: check_board_layout
title: Check PCB layout for blocking issues
